fixtureGoal: Capture the human rollback approval record shape for a release window packet without executing rollback or reading secret values.

requiredRecordFields.name: reviewer
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator records the human reviewer responsible for approving rollback.

requiredRecordFields.name: approval-timestamp-placeholder
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator replaces this placeholder with the real approval timestamp outside this fixture.

requiredRecordFields.name: rollback-target
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator records the release tag or artifact version selected for rollback review.

requiredRecordFields.name: database-migration-direction
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator records whether this release window is forward-only, rollback-script-reviewed, or no-database-change.

requiredRecordFields.name: rollback-sql-review-gate
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator confirms the SQL review gate used before any rollback SQL can be considered outside this fixture.

requiredRecordFields.name: no-secret-value-boundary
requiredRecordFields.description: Operator confirms this approval record stores metadata only and never embeds secret values.

noSecretValueBoundaries: Secret values must not be read by Java or Node when rendering this record
Secret values must not be embedded in approval record JSON
Node may render the release window packet only
forbiddenOperations: Executing Java rollback from this fixture
Executing database rollback SQL from this fixture
Connecting production database from this fixture
Reading production secret values from this fixture
Embedding secret values in approval record JSON
